meta.unit: 1 grid unit = 1 small Hesco block (~1.2m). Sizes are footprint W x D in units; height in units.
sources: In-game radial menu frames from 'How To Build In WARDOGS - Episode 1' (Wardogs Building Community)
meta.notes: Costs are Build Supplies (1 supply = $10 at vendor). CostConfirmed=false means read from low-res video frame, verify in game.

logistics.note: Build Supply Pallet is $400 and 4x2 inventory slots, and holds 1800 build supplies. Buying loose supplies at $10 each is only for topping up - the pallet is the way to actually stock a FOB.

crewSizes._note: How many players a base is built to be held by. Chosen by whoever made it, not measured: it is an intention, not a game figure. Required on a submission so the community list can say who a base is for.

options.label: 1 to 2
options.hint: A duo hold. Tight, few angles to watch.

options.label: 6 to 10
options.hint: A full team, several fronts to man.

fob.name: Forward Operating Base
effects: Holds items & resources (Build / Ammo / Fuel / Mechanical supplies)
Provides a square build radius shown blue on the minimap
Includes free Small + Medium hammers, wrenches, signal grenades at the FOB computer
fob.placement: White highlight = valid, red = obstructed. Cannot be moved after placement.
fob.startingSuppliesNote: Read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. It was 1750 before that, from a pre-launch write-up.
fob.radiusReading: 80 cells across, counted by the owner in the running game on 2026-09-02. An earlier count the same day came to 39 + 1 + 39 = 79 from the middle cell; the owner recounted and 80 stands
fob.radiusNote: The square the FOB lets you build inside, in cells, the whole side. Counted at 80 by the owner on 2026-09-02, superseding a 79 counted earlier that day (39 blocks each way from the middle cell). Before that it was 100, then 200 from 2026-08-31 as a better estimate, neither of them a reading. A design records its own zone, and one still recording 100, 200 or 79 takes this figure when it is opened, since none of those was anybody's choice. A zone typed in the panel is kept.
fob.priceNote: The vendor price above was read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02 and matched what was recorded.

buildables.name: Sandbag Wall
buildables.desc: Quick to build waist height cover. Does not require a FOB.

buildables.name: Hesco Block (Small)
buildables.desc: Durable waist-height barrier that provides cover from small arms and explosives.

buildables.name: Hesco Block (Large)
buildables.desc: Tall, durable barrier that provides full-body cover from small arms and explosives.
buildables.sizeNote: 1x1, 2 tall, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Matched what was recorded.

buildables.name: Hesco Wall (Quad)
buildables.desc: Consists of four Large Hesco Blocks. Perfect for building long perimeter walls.
buildables.sizeNote: 4x1, 2 tall, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Matched what was recorded.

buildables.name: Bremer Wall
buildables.desc: Tall reinforced concrete barrier topped with barbed wire. Cannot be built on top of; use as final anti-climb layer on top of Hesco walls.

buildables.name: Door
buildables.desc: Secure infantry access point, team-only. Auto-closes. Needs back-wall clearance to swing.
buildables.sizeNote: 1x1, 2 tall, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Matched what was recorded.

buildables.name: Gate
buildables.desc: Large armored gate for friendly vehicle access, team-only. Swings through; must be placed on the ground.

buildables.name: Barbed Wire
buildables.desc: Slows and injures enemy infantry. Does not require a FOB.

buildables.name: Hedgehog
buildables.desc: Anti-vehicle barrier used to block or channel enemy vehicles. Does not require a FOB.
buildables.sizeNote: 1x1, 1 tall, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Matched what was recorded.

buildables.name: Recon Tent
buildables.desc: Concealed recon position that hides occupants from infrared vision. Does not require a FOB.

buildables.name: Builder's Radio
buildables.desc: Plays music around your FOB, a place to get some R&R.
buildables.sizeNote: 2x1, 1 tall, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Matched what was recorded.
buildables.costNote: 13 build supplies, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Matched what was recorded.

buildables.name: Loudspeaker
buildables.desc: Climbable loudspeaker tower that lets you project your voice over long distances.

buildables.name: Bunker
buildables.desc: Offers protected firing positions and partial shelter from indirect fire.
buildables.sizeNote: 4x4, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02.

buildables.name: Indirect Fire Shelter
buildables.desc: Protection against indirect fire; four doorways for custom configuration. Roof = 9 flat Hescos (3x3), walkable/expandable platform.
buildables.sizeNote: 5x5, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Was 3x3 from a pre-launch write-up.

buildables.name: Recon Tower
buildables.desc: Two-storey tower with raised firing positions accessible by ladder. Cannot be stacked.
buildables.sizeNote: 4x4, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02.

buildables.name: L81 Mortar
buildables.desc: Short-range indirect fire. Reload converts Ammo supplies from the FOB into shells. Needs open sky and clearance over walls; keep pit walls 1 block out.
buildables.sizeNote: 3x3, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Was 4x4 from a pre-launch write-up.
buildables.costNote: 91 build supplies, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Was 90 from a pre-launch write-up.

buildables.name: Vanguard CIWS
buildables.desc: Manually operated anti-air close-in weapon system. Reload converts Ammo supplies into rounds. Needs open sky.
buildables.sizeNote: 4x4, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02.

buildables.name: Stingray
buildables.desc: Reloadable launch station for long-range, explosive anti-armor UAVs. Buy units with cash and Mechanical supplies. Holds one active UAV at a time.

perUse.note: Read off play. The station is built with Build Supplies like anything else; this is what each UAV costs on top.

buildables.sizeNote: 3x3, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Was 4x4 from a pre-launch write-up.

buildables.name: Talon 9K-SAM
buildables.desc: Reloadable heat-seeking anti-air missile station. Reload converts Ammo supplies into missiles. Needs open sky.
buildables.sizeNote: 2x2, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Was 4x4 from a pre-launch write-up.

buildables.name: Drill Rig
buildables.desc: When active, pulls the Hotzone to its location (like an active drill tower). Requires Fuel supplies in the FOB to activate; has a cooldown.
buildables.sizeNote: 3x3, 6 tall, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Was 4x4 and 4 tall from a pre-launch write-up.
buildables.costNote: 1351 build supplies, read off the running game by the owner on 2026-09-02. Matched what was recorded.

mechanics.snapping: Toggleable (default key B). Pieces snap adjacent or stacked; toggle off for free angles.
mechanics.placement: Free placement with rotation; white/valid vs red/obstructed preview.
mechanics.criticalHits: Yellow X marks appear while building; hitting them speeds construction (Fortnite-style). Swing-cancel (release + re-press between contacts) roughly 3x build speed.
mechanics.stacking: Hescos and most pieces stack for multi-level builds; stack height limit exists ('exceeds stack limit'). Gates ground-only; Bremer walls cannot be built upon; recon towers cannot stack.
mechanics.vaulting: Waist-height items (sandbag, small hesco) are vaultable; plan anti-vault layers (tall hesco + bremer on top).
mechanics.economy: Building earns cash + Support XP. Supplies must be trucked/flown from HQ as pallets and unloaded into the FOB.
